g.text: Validity and reward: what counts, what stays raw
Raw reward is immutable. Flags go to adjudication. counts.verdict excludes deterministically; train_eligible is a separate gate (unreviewed suspicion holds admission). | base ae103f70, 2026-10-05
• terminal hooks / testmain / conftest not plantable
• setup-healthcheck-only: runners skipping setup are ungradable
• split groups must not straddle train / held-out
• MiMo published recipe (§4.2.6, pp14-16): scrub caches/Git, isolate net,
hack-agent probes + offline audits — their report, not our measurement
Harbor job dir + result.json: the only reward source
missing reward (setup / judge down / timeout) ≠ fail, ≠ 0
• classifier, watch alert, or investigator never edits raw reward
• rerun verifier x3 (MiMo recipe used x8): flaky → noise, not signal
• errors excluded from training batches; controls get own rows
• provenance: trial → job → experiment_id; sha-pinned lists
GLM intent-judge is a claim; mimoagent ships regex-only + stub.
METR: each screen misses cases ‒ audit non-flags too.
Ari 2% FPR is not 98% precision and does not transfer.
Guard reject is a recorded taint event, not proof of cheating.
no confirmed exploit · no unreviewed suspicion
no hard finding · held-out excluded at export
Repairs create new versions; original stays as control.
Sources: docs/task-quality.md:77-81, src/evallab/counts.py, docs/mimo-task-catalog.md, docs/task-stability.md, src/evallab/mimo_exploit.py, docs/verdicts.md, REFERENCE-MAP.md §§3-4.
